articles.summary: Earning Asset Growth and Net Interest Margin Expansion Lead to a 17.5% Increase in Third Quarter Earnings The First Bancorp (Nasdaq: FNLC), ("the Company", "we", "us", "our"), parent company of First National Bank, today reported unaudited results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Net income for the third quarter was $10.7 million with fully diluted earnings per share of $0.95, increases of 17.5% and 16.8%, respectively, from net income of $9.1 million and diluted earnings per share of $0.81 for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Strong earnings for the period were driven by growth in earning assets, continued net interest margin expansion, enhanced non-interest income, and disciplined expense control. Year-to-date in 2026, net income stands at $29.2 million with fully diluted earnings per share of $2.59, increases of 20.7% and 19.9%, respectively, from net income of $24.2 million and earnings per share of $2.16 for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
articles.title: The First Bancorp Announces Third Quarter Results
